categories.main_business_segments: Mango Excellent Media Co., Ltd. operates primarily in three segments: Mango TV internet video services, new media interactive entertainment content production and operation, and content e-commerce. The company also engages in artist management, music copyright, IP derivatives, and operates a comprehensive media ecosystem integrating content creation, distribution, and commercialization.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced digital media technologies including AI-generated content (AIGC), virtual reality (VR), augmented reality (AR), and cloud computing to enhance content production and distribution. It has developed a proprietary intelligent media service platform and employs a '532' amortization method for video copyrights. The company also uses a 'track owner' system and studio management to optimize content creation efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include individual subscribers to Mango TV's membership services, advertisers from sectors such as dairy, healthcare, and liquor, telecom operators for content distribution, and consumers engaging in content-driven e-commerce. The company serves the cultural media market domestically in China and internationally through its Mango TV International App, targeting young global audiences.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with significant revenue generated both within Hunan Province and other regions across the country. It also has a growing international presence via its Mango TV International App, which covers 195 countries and regions worldwide, supporting multiple languages and subtitles.
categories.supply_chain_position: Mango Excellent Media operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the media supply chain, focusing on content creation, platform operation, and direct consumer engagement through membership, advertising, and e-commerce. It controls the full content production pipeline and distribution channels, including IPTV and OTT licenses.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes the integration of culture and technology, focusing on AI-driven content creation, intelligent media platforms, and immersive technologies like VR and AR. It invests heavily in R&D to build a leading smart audiovisual media service platform, enhance content innovation, and expand international market penetration. Key projects include the 'Mango Big Model' AI lab and micro-short video content development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through multiple streams: subscription fees from Mango TV members, advertising sales including branded content and product placements, revenue sharing with telecom operators, content licensing and distribution, artist management and music copyright licensing, and sales from content-driven e-commerce platforms.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Mango Excellent Media is a leading state-owned player in China's internet video and new media sector, recognized as the only state-controlled long-video new media platform in the A-share market. It ranks among the top 20 internet companies in China and holds a dominant position in variety show production and distribution. Competitors include Tencent Video, iQIYI, Youku, and other major streaming platforms.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 14.08 billion, a slight decrease of 3.75% year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders at RMB 1.36 billion, down 61.63% mainly due to tax policy adjustments. Total assets reached RMB 32.53 billion, showing steady growth. Membership revenue surpassed RMB 5 billion, growing 19.3%, becoming the core growth driver.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its unique position as a state-owned mainstream media platform with strong ideological guidance and cultural influence. It differentiates through exclusive content production, a robust IP ecosystem, multi-platform integration (including IPTV and OTT licenses), and innovative use of AI and immersive technologies to enhance user engagement and content monetization. Its clear user demographic focus on youth and female audiences strengthens targeted marketing and membership growth.
